subject: Acme Analytics evaluation — proposed milestones & stakeholders
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Verma <priya@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap & proposed next steps from today's call

Hi Priya — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap while it's fresh: 

Pain points you shared
- Production inference cost for embedding and chat is spiking with peak batch traffic (20–30% above forecast).
- Reliability concerns during end-of-month reporting windows; spikes lead to timeouts and degraded UX.
- Need for audit logs and tighter data residency controls for EU customers.

Goals we heard
1) Reduce per-token inference cost by ~25% on average through batching + quantization without increasing 95th percentile latency.
2) Stabilize latency during reporting windows to meet a 300ms 95th target for chat flows.
3) Produce a plan for Private deployment (VPC) and SOC2 evidence for procurement in Q2.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level) — details attached in MAP-Acme-Phase1.xlsx:
- Week of Mar 9: Technical workshop (redwood SE + Acme infra) to validate traffic profile and test prefix/KV caching. Owner: Connor O'Brien.
- Mar 16–20: POC run on a Dedicated pool with pilot quantization profile; measure cost/latency delta. Owner: Vivek Kulkarni.
- Mar 23: Security/compliance review — deliver SOC2 docs and data residency options; owner: Evelyn Hart.
- Mar 30: Decision meeting; Acme to confirm deployment path (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). Owner: Priya Verma (Acme).

Next steps for your team
- Confirm availability for the week-of-Mar-9 technical workshop (2 hours).
- Share list of Acme infra contacts who should join (we'll need someone from cloud infra + procurement).

Attachments: MAP-Acme-Phase1.xlsx (milestones + dates), SOW-draft-acme.pdf (initial scope/pricing placeholder).

If that aligns, I'll pull together calendar invites and a one-page SOW summary for your procurement team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Adding a bit of technical color for the workshop so Acme can prep: 

Workshop agenda (60–90 mins)- Traffic profile & token distribution review (Acme to share 48h sample CSV)- Live walkthrough of Redwood's batching and prefix caching settings with sample workload- Quantization options: fp16 vs 4-bit experiment plan and expected latency/cost tradeoffs- Test harness & metrics we'll collect (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, error rates)

Pre-reqs for an effective session- A service account with read-only access to the sample traffic bucket (or an anonymized CSV)- A contact from Acme infra who can discuss network egress and VPC peering options

I'll bring the test harness and a checklist for the Dedicated pilot. If it helps, we can also run a small A/B during the pilot to compare current live traffic against the pilot's responses.
